items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Zutty Singleton) does not speak in the provided context. The name 'Dick Slevin' is mentioned by the Interviewer and confirmed by a third party (Mrs. S) in the context of Charlie Parker's early days, but Zutty Singleton provides no personal testimony or connection.

ctx.x: No, no, the Arcadian was like Roselord, and we were the first black band to play. They got Charlie to play at this hall on Pine Street. That's where it was -- in those days it was segregation, it wasn't integrated. It was all white at this dance hall, and that's where Jack Bland and --
Dick Slevin. They used to -- they were bell hops, they loved music --
